title: The Candle in the Window (The Parable of the Stew)
summary: Having survived an entire freezing night on the snowy mountain by watching a candle flame a mile away, Nasruddin was denied his wager by greedy elders who claimed the distant candl...
full_text:
Having survived an entire freezing night on the snowy mountain by watching a candle flame a mile away, Nasruddin was denied his wager by greedy elders who claimed the distant candle had warmed him.

When they arrived at his house for dinner, he showed them a cauldron of stew hanging five feet above a tiny candle on the floor.

"How can that candle cook the stew?" they shouted.

"If it could warm a grown man through a blizzard a mile away," smiled Nasruddin, "it can surely cook stew five feet above it!" The elders bowed in shame and paid the wager.
moral: Those who use absurd excuses to cheat others must taste their own medicine.
